hooks.command: BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo '[C-001] Pushing to main = production deploy trigger. CONFIRM: have all unit tests been run and passed 100%? If not, abort and run /run-tests first.'; else echo '[C-001] Non-main push OK. Tests required before merging to main.'; fi
echo '[HOOK] git merge detected — deterministic gate: verify test runner result before merge'
echo '[CONSTRAINT] Deploy qua vercel CLI không dùng cho project này. Deploy = git push origin main (Vercel auto-deploy). Xem CLAUDE.md section Deploy.' && exit 1
